A quick weeknight dinner: One‑pan lemon‑garlic chicken with roasted potatoes and broccoli. Ingredients (serves 2): 2 chicken thighs, 1 lb baby potatoes, 2 cups broccoli florets, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 garlic cloves minced, zest & juice of 1 lemon, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt, pepper. Toss potatoes & broccoli with 2 tbsp oil, salt, pepper; spread on baking sheet. Place chicken skin‑side up, drizzle with remaining oil, rub with garlic, lemon zest, juice, oregano, salt, pepper. Roast 425°F 25‑30 min until chicken reaches 165°F and veggies are tender. Serve with pan juices.
